name: Screenwriting
title: Screenwriter
intro: Screenwriters craft compelling scripts for films, television series, and digital platforms, shaping narratives through structured dialogue and scene descriptions. The role demands a unique blend of visual storytelling instinct and disciplined adherence to screenplay formatting standards.
whoShouldPursue: Passionate about crafting stories for visual media
Enjoy working alone for extended creative stretches
Have a strong sense of dramatic structure and pacing
Are fascinated by character dialogue and subtext
eligibility: Strong command of screenplay format and three-act structure
Demonstrated writing portfolio or short-film scripts
Film school training or self-taught through published screenplays
Understanding of cinematic grammar and visual storytelling
workDesc: Developing original screenplays or adapting existing material into structured scripts for film, TV, or streaming productions.
workExamples: Writing an original feature-length screenplay for an independent Hindi film
Adapting a bestselling novel into a limited web-series script for a streaming platform
Pitching and selling a television pilot to a production house
futureOutlook: Growing demand from OTT platforms is creating more opportunities for skilled screenwriters in Indian and global markets.

name: Broadcast Journalism
title: Broadcast Journalist
intro: Broadcast journalists research, write, and present news stories for television and radio platforms, working under strict deadlines in high-pressure newsroom environments. The role combines on-camera or on-air presence with journalistic rigour and real-time editorial judgment.
whoShouldPursue: Comfortable speaking or presenting on camera or microphone
Thrive under tight deadlines and breaking-news pressure
Have strong news sense and ethical judgement
Enjoy field reporting and engaging with diverse sources
eligibility: Degree in Journalism or Mass Communication
Proficiency in news writing and broadcast presentation
Internship or experience in a newsroom or production studio
Familiarity with live broadcasting equipment and workflows
workDesc: Researching, reporting, and presenting news stories for television or radio broadcasts within strict editorial and time constraints.
workExamples: Anchoring a primetime national news bulletin on a Hindi news channel
Reporting live from a disaster-affected region with a camera crew
Producing a weekly investigative segment for a radio news programme
futureOutlook: Traditional broadcast roles are shrinking, but digital-first news channels and podcast news formats are opening new pathways.

name: Documentary Production
title: Documentary Producer
intro: Documentary producers plan, research, and oversee the creation of long-form non-fiction films that explore real-world issues, cultures, and events. The role blends journalistic research with cinematic craft to produce compelling narratives rooted in truth.
whoShouldPursue: Deeply curious about real-world issues and human stories
Comfortable with prolonged research and fieldwork
Can balance artistic vision with factual accuracy
Are self-motivated and able to manage multi-month projects
eligibility: Background in film, journalism, or social sciences
Strong research and interview skills
Ability to manage budgets, crews, and post-production
Portfolio of short documentary work or relevant internships
workDesc: Leading the end-to-end creation of documentary films from research and scripting through production and post-production.
workExamples: Producing a feature-length documentary on water scarcity in Rajasthan for an international film festival
Creating a short documentary series on indigenous artisans for a streaming platform
Shooting and editing an investigative documentary on urban waste management
futureOutlook: Rising demand for non-fiction content on streaming platforms and growing NGO and social-impact funding is driving steady growth.

name: Technical Writing
title: Technical Writer
intro: Technical writers create precise, user-friendly documentation such as user manuals, API references, and software guides that make complex information accessible. The role combines linguistic clarity, logical thinking, and the ability to learn highly technical subject matter.
whoShouldPursue: Enjoy distilling complex ideas into clear, structured content
Are methodical and detail-oriented by nature
Have an aptitude for understanding technical systems
Prefer working independently with minimal supervision
eligibility: Strong command of English and technical writing conventions
Familiarity with documentation tools like Markdown, DITA, or MadCap Flare
Basic understanding of software development or engineering concepts
Portfolio of technical documents or help articles
workDesc: Producing clear, accurate documentation for software products, engineering systems, or technical processes.
workExamples: Writing API reference documentation and developer guides for a SaaS platform
Creating user manuals and onboarding guides for enterprise software
Developing internal knowledge-base articles for IT support teams
futureOutlook: Expanding software product ecosystems and AI-driven tools are increasing demand for skilled technical writers who produce high-quality documentation.

name: Copywriting
title: Copywriter
intro: Copywriters craft short, persuasive text for advertisements, campaigns, taglines, and marketing materials that drive audience action. The role demands an instinct for consumer psychology, brevity, and the ability to adapt tone and voice across brands and platforms.
whoShouldPursue: Have a natural feel for persuasive and concise language
Enjoy brainstorming catchy phrases, headlines, and slogans
Can switch writing styles to match different brand voices
Are energised by fast-paced, campaign-driven work
eligibility: Strong portfolio of advertising or marketing copy samples
Understanding of consumer behaviour and brand positioning
Ability to work with creative directors and marketing teams
Proficiency in both English and regional language copywriting
workDesc: Writing compelling advertising copy, taglines, product descriptions, and campaign content for brands across digital and print channels.
workExamples: Crafting a tagline and print ad campaign for a new FMCG product launch
Writing persuasive social media ad copy for an e-commerce brand's sale event
Developing product descriptions and landing-page copy for a tech startup
futureOutlook: While AI tools automate basic copy tasks, brands increasingly value human creativity for emotionally resonant and culturally nuanced campaigns.

name: Photojournalism
title: Photojournalist
intro: Photojournalists capture powerful images that document news events, social issues, and human stories, combining photographic skill with journalistic integrity. The role demands physical courage, ethical judgement, and the ability to convey complex narratives through a single frame.
whoShouldPursue: Are passionate about visual storytelling and current affairs
Can work in challenging and sometimes dangerous field conditions
Have a strong photographic portfolio with a news or documentary focus
Value truth and accuracy in visual representation
eligibility: Proficiency in photography with a focus on news or documentary work
Understanding of journalistic ethics and press protocols
Ability to write accurate captions and accompanying text
Experience shooting in diverse and unpredictable environments
workDesc: Photographing breaking news, feature stories, and documentary projects for publication in newspapers, magazines, and digital media.
workExamples: Covering a national election with on-ground photo stories for a major English daily
Documenting the daily lives of migrant workers for a long-form photo essay
Shooting conflict-zone images for an international wire agency
futureOutlook: Digital media expansion is sustaining demand, though print decline and freelance competition make the field highly competitive.

name: Media Planning
title: Media Planner
intro: Media planners research audience data and select the most effective channels and schedules to deliver advertising campaigns within budget. The role sits at the intersection of marketing strategy, analytics, and creative collaboration, requiring both quantitative rigour and market awareness.
whoShouldPursue: Are analytical and comfortable working with data and metrics
Have a keen interest in advertising trends and consumer media habits
Can balance creative aspirations with budget constraints
Enjoy strategic thinking and long-term campaign planning
eligibility: Degree in Mass Communication, Marketing, or related field
Proficiency with media analytics tools and audience measurement systems
Understanding of digital and traditional media channels
Strong analytical and budgeting skills
workDesc: Developing media strategies that identify the optimal mix of channels, timing, and budgets to reach target audiences for advertising campaigns.
workExamples: Designing a multi-channel media plan for a national automobile brand launch
Allocating digital ad spend across social media, YouTube, and programmatic platforms for a D2C brand
Negotiating television prime-time slots for a consumer electronics festive campaign
futureOutlook: The shift toward data-driven advertising and programmatic buying is increasing demand for media planners who navigate both traditional and digital ecosystems.

name: Publishing
title: Publishing Professional
intro: Publishing professionals oversee the acquisition, editing, production, and distribution of books, journals, and digital publications. The role demands a love of language, sharp editorial judgement, and an understanding of both the creative and commercial dimensions of bringing written works to market.
whoShouldPursue: Have a deep passion for books, reading, and written content
Are detail-oriented with strong grammatical and editorial instincts
Can balance creative taste with commercial viability
Are interested in the business side of content distribution
eligibility: Strong command of English and editorial standards
Experience in editing, proofreading, or manuscript evaluation
Knowledge of publishing workflows and production processes
Familiarity with digital publishing platforms and trends
workDesc: Managing the editorial and production lifecycle of books and publications from manuscript acquisition through to distribution and marketing.
workExamples: Acquiring and editing a debut novelist's manuscript for a major publishing house
Managing the editorial pipeline for an academic journal with quarterly publication cycles
Overseeing e-book formatting and distribution across digital platforms
futureOutlook: Print publishing is stabilising while digital and audiobook formats grow, creating hybrid roles that blend traditional editorial skills with digital distribution knowledge.
